solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/same-tree/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

100. Same Tree

Given the roots of two binary trees p and q, write a function to check if they are the same or not.

Two binary trees are considered the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value.

Example 1:

Input: p = [1,2,3], q = [1,2,3]
Output: true

Example 2:

Input: p = [1,2], q = [1,null,2]
Output: false

Example 3:

Input: p = [1,2,1], q = [1,1,2]
Output: false

Constraints:

    The number of nodes in both trees is in the range [0, 100].
    -10^4 <= Node.val <= 10^4
"""


class Solution:
    def isSameTree(self, p: Optional[TreeNode], q: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        if not p and not q:
            return True
        if not p or not q:
            return False
        if p.val != q.val:
            return False
        return self.isSameTree(p.left, q.left) and self.isSameTree(p.right, q.right)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 2, 3]), build_tree([1, 2, 3])))  # True

assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 2, 3]), build_tree([1, 2, 3])) == True
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 2]), build_tree([1, None, 2])) == False
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 2, 1]), build_tree([1, 1, 2])) == False

assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([]), build_tree([])) == True
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([0]), build_tree([0])) == True
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 1, 1, 1, 1]), build_tree([1, 1, 1, 1, 1])) == True
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]), build_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]))
    == True
)
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(
        build_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]), build_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, None])
    )
    == False
)
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([-10, -20, -30]), build_tree([-10, -20, -30])) == True
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([-10, -20, -30]), build_tree([-10, -20, -31])) == False
assert sol.isSameTree(build_tree([10000] * 100), build_tree([10000] * 100)) == True
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(build_tree([10000] * 100), build_tree([10000] * 99 + [9999]))
    == False
)
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, None, 2, None, 3]), build_tree([1, None, 2, None, 3]))
    == True
)
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(build_tree([1, None, 2, None, 3]), build_tree([1, None, 2, None, 4]))
    == False
)
assert (
    sol.isSameTree(
        build_tree([1, 2, 2, 3, None, None, 3]), build_tree([1, 2, 2, 3, None, None, 3])
    )
    == True
)
